subject: income_type
statement: The calculator asks which income the source tax tariff is to be determined for.

anchors.quote: Für welche Einkünfte möchten Sie den Quellensteuertarif ermitteln?

subject: income_type
statement: Income type options are exactly: Erwerbseinkommen (earned income) and Ersatzeinkünfte (replacement income).

subject: income_type
statement: The income type question is always shown and is the first question.

anchors.quote: Für welche Einkünfte möchten Sie den Quellensteuertarif ermitteln?

subject: income_type
statement: If the income type is Ersatzeinkünfte, all personal and child questions are skipped and the calculator goes straight to the main-residence question (Q16).

anchors.quote: Ersatzeinkünfte skips all personal/child questions and goes straight to Q16.

subject: civil_status
statement: For earned income, the calculator asks for the civil status of the person subject to source tax.

subject: civil_status
statement: Civil status options are exactly two groups: 'Verheiratet oder eingetragene Partnerschaft' (married or registered partnership) and 'Ledig, Geschieden, Getrennt, Verwitwet' (single, divorced, separated, widowed).

anchors.quote: Options: Verheiratet oder eingetragene Partnerschaft | Ledig, Geschieden, Getrennt, Verwitwet

subject: civil_status
statement: Civil status is asked only when the income type is Erwerbseinkommen.

subject: confession
statement: For earned income, the calculator asks for the confession (religious denomination) of the person.

subject: confession
statement: Confession options are exactly: 'röm.-kath., christ.-kath., evang.-ref.' and 'Keine oder andere' (none or other).

anchors.quote: Options: röm.-kath., christ.-kath., evang.-ref. | Keine oder andere

subject: confession
statement: Confession is asked only when the income type is Erwerbseinkommen and civil status has been answered.

subject: confession
statement: Confession sets the church-tax suffix of the tariff: Y for röm.-kath./christ.-kath./evang.-ref., N for none or other (e.g. A0Y vs A0N).

anchors.quote: Sets the church-tax suffix: Y = röm.-kath., christ.-kath., evang.-ref.; N = Keine oder andere

subject: spouse_gainful_employment
statement: For married persons / registered partners, the calculator asks whether the spouse/registered partner is gainfully employed or receives replacement income.

anchors.quote: Ist der Ehegatte / eingetragene Partner erwerbstätig oder bezieht er/sie Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: spouse_gainful_employment
statement: Spouse employment options are Ja / Nein.

subject: spouse_gainful_employment
statement: The spouse employment question is shown only when civil status is 'Verheiratet oder eingetragene Partnerschaft'.

anchors.quote: Ist der Ehegatte / eingetragene Partner erwerbstätig oder bezieht er/sie Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: base_tariff
statement: For married/registered partners, a spouse who is employed or receives replacement income leads to tariff C; otherwise tariff B.

anchors.quote: Ja -> C tariff; Nein -> B tariff

subject: base_tariff
statement: A single/divorced/separated/widowed person without counted children with earned income and residence in Switzerland gets tariff A (A0Y/A0N).

subject: children
statement: For married persons, the calculator asks whether the person or the spouses/partners have biological or adopted children.

anchors.quote: Leibliche oder adoptierte Kinder der Person oder der Ehegatten bzw. Partner?

subject: children
statement: Children question (married) options are Ja / Nein.

subject: children
statement: The married children question is shown only when civil status is 'Verheiratet oder eingetragene Partnerschaft' and the spouse employment question is answered.

anchors.quote: Leibliche oder adoptierte Kinder der Person oder der Ehegatten bzw. Partner?

subject: children
statement: For non-married persons, the calculator asks whether the person has biological or adopted children.

anchors.quote: Leibliche oder adoptierte Kinder der Person?

subject: children
statement: Children question (non-married) options are Ja / Nein.

subject: children
statement: The non-married children question is shown only when civil status is 'Ledig, Geschieden, Getrennt, Verwitwet' and confession is answered.

anchors.quote: Leibliche oder adoptierte Kinder der Person?

subject: child_age_status
statement: For each child, the calculator asks whether the child is minor, or adult and in first education.

anchors.quote: Kind minderjährig oder volljährig und in Erstausbildung?

subject: child_age_status
statement: Child age status options are exactly: Minderjährig, Volljährig und in Erstausbildung, weder noch.

anchors.quote: Options: Minderjährig | Volljährig und in Erstausbildung | weder noch

subject: child_age_status
statement: The child questions are shown only when the person answered Ja to having children (Q05 or Q06), with one block per child ('Kind 1', 'Kind 2', …).

subject: children
statement: Child questions repeat per child; 'Ein weiteres Kind erfassen' adds another child block and 'Kind löschen' removes one. Each completed block shows a per-child result ('Kind Ergebnis').

anchors.quote: A link button 'Ein weiteres Kind erfassen' adds another child block, and each block has a 'Kind löschen' button.
Child questions repeat for each child (input names child-1__…, child-2__…).

subject: child_age_status
statement: A child answered 'weder noch' (neither minor nor adult in first education) ends the child block and does not count towards the tariff.

anchors.quote: 'weder noch' ends the child block right away (child does not count).

subject: child_same_household
statement: For each minor or adult-in-first-education child, the calculator asks whether the child lives in the same household.

anchors.quote: Wohnsitz des Kindes im selben Haushalt?

subject: child_same_household
statement: Same-household options are Ja / Nein.

subject: child_same_household
statement: The same-household question is shown only when the child is Minderjährig or Volljährig und in Erstausbildung.

anchors.quote: Wohnsitz des Kindes im selben Haushalt?

subject: parental_custody
statement: For a minor child in the same household, the calculator asks about parental custody (shared or sole).

anchors.quote: Elterliche Sorge Options: Geteiltes Sorgerecht | Alleiniges Sorgerecht

subject: parental_custody
statement: Parental custody options (child in household) are exactly: Geteiltes Sorgerecht (shared) and Alleiniges Sorgerecht (sole).

subject: parental_custody
statement: The custody question (Q09) is shown only when the child is Minderjährig and lives in the same household, for both civil status groups.

subject: common_household_other_parent
statement: The calculator asks whether the person lives in a common household with the other parent.

anchors.quote: Gemeinsamer Haushalt mit dem anderen Elternteil?

subject: common_household_other_parent
statement: Common-household-with-other-parent options are Ja / Nein.

subject: common_household_other_parent
statement: The common-household question is shown only when (child minor, in same household, shared custody) or (child adult in first education and in same household).

anchors.quote: Gemeinsamer Haushalt mit dem anderen Elternteil?

subject: alternating_custody
statement: The calculator asks whether there is alternating custody (alternierende Obhut).

subject: alternating_custody
statement: Alternating custody options are Ja / Nein.

subject: alternating_custody
statement: Alternating custody is asked only for a minor child when: (in household, shared custody, no common household with other parent) or (married, not in household, shared custody Q13 = Ja) or (non-married, not in household, parental care Q14 = Ja).

subject: main_financial_contributor
statement: The calculator asks who makes the larger financial contribution to the child's maintenance.

anchors.quote: Wer leistet den grösseren finanziellen Beitrag an den Unterhalt des Kindes?

subject: main_financial_contributor
statement: Main contributor options are exactly: Quellensteuerpflichtige Person (the person subject to source tax) and Anderer Elternteil (other parent).

subject: main_financial_contributor
statement: The main-contributor question is shown when alternating custody = Ja, or for non-married persons when the child is in the household and there is a common household with the other parent; for married persons a common household with the other parent ends the child block without it.

anchors.quote: Wer leistet den grösseren finanziellen Beitrag an den Unterhalt des Kindes?

subject: shared_custody
statement: For married persons with a minor child not in the household, the calculator asks whether custody is shared (Geteiltes Sorgerecht).

subject: shared_custody
statement: Shared custody (Q13) options are Ja / Nein.

subject: shared_custody
statement: Q13 is shown only when civil status is married/registered partnership, the child is minor and not in the same household.

subject: parental_custody
statement: For non-married persons with a minor child not in the household, the calculator asks whether they have parental care (Elterliche Sorge, yes/no).

anchors.quote: Same title as Q09, but with Ja/Nein options (internal name child-n__parentalCare)

subject: parental_custody
statement: Parental care (Q14) options are Ja / Nein.

subject: parental_custody
statement: Q14 is shown only when civil status is 'Ledig, Geschieden, Getrennt, Verwitwet', the child is minor and not in the same household.

subject: child_maintenance_over_50
statement: For adult children in first education, the calculator asks whether more than 50% of the child's maintenance is mainly provided.

anchors.quote: Wird zur Hauptsache (mehr als 50%) für den Kindsunterhalt aufgekommen?

subject: child_maintenance_over_50
statement: Maintenance >50% options are Ja / Nein.

subject: child_maintenance_over_50
statement: Q15 is shown only when the child is adult in first education and either not in the same household, or in the household without a common household with the other parent.

anchors.quote: Wird zur Hauptsache (mehr als 50%) für den Kindsunterhalt aufgekommen?

subject: child_count
statement: The tariff digit equals the number of children whose per-child result digit is 1 (e.g. three counted children -> C3Y).

anchors.quote: The final tariff's digit equals the number of children whose 'Kind Ergebnis' digit is 1.

subject: tariff_h
statement: For a single/divorced/separated/widowed person, any child counted with H gives an H tariff; a child counts with H when it lives in the household and the person has sole custody or is the main financial contributor.

anchors.quote: For a single person, any child counted with H gives an H tariff (e.g. A1 + H1 -> H2N). A child is counted with H when it lives in the household and the person has sole custody or is the main financial contributor.

subject: child_count
statement: A minor child in the same household with sole custody counts as a child (married: C1/B1; single: H1).

subject: child_count
statement: Married, minor child in household, shared custody and common household with the other parent: the child counts (C1Y).

subject: child_count
statement: Married, minor child in household, shared custody, no common household: alternating custody with the other parent as main contributor, or no alternating custody, gives C0Y (child not counted).

subject: child_count
statement: Single, minor child in household, shared custody, no common household and no alternating custody gives H1N (child counted with H).

subject: child_count
statement: Single, minor child in household, shared custody, common household with the other parent and other parent as main contributor gives A0N.

anchors.quote: "Q12": "Anderer Elternteil", "Q16": "Ja"} -> result Tarif: A0N (Kind Ergebnis: A0)

subject: child_count
statement: Minor child not in the household: with shared custody/parental care, alternating custody and the person as main contributor, the child counts (married B1N, single H1N); without shared custody/parental care it does not count (B0N, A0N).

subject: child_count
statement: Adult child in first education: in household with common household (married) counts (B1N); not in household counts only if more than 50% of maintenance is provided (single A1N; married with Nein -> B0N); single, in household without common household and >50% maintenance gives H1N.

subject: main_residence_switzerland
statement: The calculator asks whether the main residence is in Switzerland.

subject: main_residence_switzerland
statement: Main residence in Switzerland options are Ja / Nein.

subject: main_residence_switzerland
statement: The main-residence question is shown for Ersatzeinkünfte, or once all personal and child questions are answered; adding an unanswered child block hides it again.

anchors.quote: While a child block is unanswered, the residence question Q16 is hidden.

subject: residence_country
statement: If the main residence is not in Switzerland, the calculator asks for the country of residence.

subject: residence_country
statement: Country of residence options are exactly: Deutschland, Liechtenstein, Anderes Land (other country).

subject: residence_country
statement: The country of residence question is shown only when main residence in Switzerland = Nein.

subject: daily_return_germany
statement: For earned income with residence in Germany, the calculator asks whether the person returns daily to the main residence in Germany.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Deutschland?

subject: daily_return_germany
statement: Daily return to Germany options are Ja / Nein.

subject: daily_return_germany
statement: Q18 is shown only when income type is Erwerbseinkommen and country of residence is Deutschland.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Deutschland?

subject: residence_certificate
statement: The calculator asks whether a certificate of residence (Ansässigkeitsbescheinigung) has been provided.

subject: residence_certificate
statement: Residence certificate options are Ja / Nein.

subject: residence_certificate
statement: The residence certificate question is shown only when the person (Germany resident) returns daily (Q18 = Ja for earned income, Q24 = Ja for replacement income).

subject: cross_border_tariff
statement: Germany resident with daily return and a residence certificate gets the cross-border (Grenzgänger) tariff: A->L, B->M, C->N, H->P, G->Q; without a certificate the normal tariff applies.

anchors.quote: Ja -> cross-border (Grenzgänger) tariff: A->L, B->M, C->N, H->P, G->Q; Nein -> normal tariff

subject: daily_return_reasonable
statement: For earned income, Germany residents without daily return are asked whether daily return is basically reasonable (less than 100 km driving distance).

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr grundsätzlich zumutbar (weniger als 100km Fahrdistanz)?

subject: daily_return_reasonable
statement: Daily return reasonable options are Ja / Nein.

subject: daily_return_reasonable
statement: Q20 is shown only when income type is Erwerbseinkommen, country is Deutschland and daily return = Nein.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr grundsätzlich zumutbar (weniger als 100km Fahrdistanz)?

subject: non_return_days_60
statement: The calculator asks whether proof of more than 60 work-related non-return days in the calendar year has been provided.

anchors.quote: Nachweis von mehr als 60 beruflich bedingten Nichtrückkehrtagen im Kalenderjahr beigebracht?

subject: non_return_days_60
statement: Proof of >60 non-return days options are Ja / Nein.

subject: non_return_days_60
statement: Q21 is shown only when daily return is reasonable (Q20 = Ja).

anchors.quote: Nachweis von mehr als 60 beruflich bedingten Nichtrückkehrtagen im Kalenderjahr beigebracht?

subject: cross_border_tariff
statement: Germany resident without daily return: if return is not reasonable -> normal tariff; if reasonable and >60 non-return days proven -> normal tariff; if reasonable and no proof -> cross-border tariff (L/M/N/P, Q).

anchors.quote: Ja -> normal tariff; Nein -> cross-border tariff (L/M/N/P)

subject: daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: For earned income with residence in Liechtenstein, the calculator asks whether the person returns daily to the main residence in Liechtenstein.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Liechtenstein?

subject: daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: Daily return to Liechtenstein options are Ja / Nein.

subject: daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: Q22 is shown only when income type is Erwerbseinkommen and country is Liechtenstein.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Liechtenstein?

subject: non_return_days_45
statement: Liechtenstein residents without daily return are asked whether they have more than 45 work-related non-return days in the calendar year.

anchors.quote: Mehr als 45 beruflich bedingte Nichtrückkehrtage im Kalenderjahr?

subject: non_return_days_45
statement: More than 45 non-return days options are Ja / Nein.

subject: non_return_days_45
statement: Q23 is shown only when daily return to Liechtenstein = Nein.

anchors.quote: Mehr als 45 beruflich bedingte Nichtrückkehrtage im Kalenderjahr?

subject: subject_to_source_tax
statement: Liechtenstein residents with daily return, or without daily return and not more than 45 non-return days, get 'Grundsätzlich keine Quellensteuerpflicht' (in principle no source tax liability), subject to the double taxation agreement.

anchors.quote: "Q22": "Ja"} -> result Grundsätzlich keine Quellensteuerpflicht / Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens

subject: subject_to_source_tax
statement: Liechtenstein residents without daily return and more than 45 non-return days get the normal tariff plus 'Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens'.

anchors.quote: Ja -> normal tariff + 'Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens'
result Tarif: C1Y / Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens
result Tarif: G / Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens

subject: base_tariff
statement: Residence in Switzerland or in 'Anderes Land' gives the base tariff without further residence questions.

subject: base_tariff
statement: Replacement income (Ersatzeinkünfte) yields tariff G (cross-border variant Q), without child digit or confession suffix.

subject: daily_return_germany
statement: For replacement income with residence in Germany, the calculator asks whether the person returned daily to the main residence in Germany during or before receiving the replacement income.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Deutschland während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: daily_return_germany
statement: Q24 options are Ja / Nein.

subject: daily_return_germany
statement: Q24 is shown only when income type is Ersatzeinkünfte and country is Deutschland.

anchors.quote: während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: daily_return_reasonable
statement: For replacement income, Germany residents without daily return are asked whether daily return was basically reasonable (less than 100 km) during or before receipt of the replacement income.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr grundsätzlich zumutbar während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte (weniger als 100km Fahrdistanz)?

subject: daily_return_reasonable
statement: Q25 options are Ja / Nein.

subject: daily_return_reasonable
statement: Q25 is shown only when income type is Ersatzeinkünfte, country is Deutschland and Q24 = Nein.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr grundsätzlich zumutbar während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte

subject: non_return_days_60
statement: For replacement income, the calculator asks whether proof of more than 60 work-related non-return days in the calendar year was provided during or before receipt of the replacement income.

anchors.quote: Nachweis von mehr als 60 beruflich bedingten Nichtrückkehrtagen im Kalenderjahr beigebracht während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: non_return_days_60
statement: Q26 options are Ja / Nein.

subject: non_return_days_60
statement: Q26 is shown only when Q25 = Ja.

anchors.quote: beigebracht während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: cross_border_tariff
statement: Replacement income, Germany: daily return with certificate -> Q; daily return without certificate -> G; no daily return, reasonable, no >60-day proof -> Q; with proof -> G; not reasonable -> G.

subject: daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: For replacement income with residence in Liechtenstein, the calculator asks whether the person returned daily to the main residence in Liechtenstein during or before receipt of the replacement income.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Liechtenstein während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: Q27 options are Ja / Nein.

subject: daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: Q27 is shown only when income type is Ersatzeinkünfte and country is Liechtenstein.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Liechtenstein während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: non_return_days_45
statement: For replacement income, Liechtenstein residents without daily return are asked whether they had more than 45 work-related non-return days in the calendar year during or before receipt of the replacement income.

anchors.quote: Mehr als 45 beruflich bedingte Nichtrückkehrtage im Kalenderjahr während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: non_return_days_45
statement: Q28 options are Ja / Nein.

subject: non_return_days_45
statement: Q28 is shown only when Q27 = Nein.

anchors.quote: Mehr als 45 beruflich bedingte Nichtrückkehrtage im Kalenderjahr während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: calculator_scope
statement: The calculator determines the source tax tariff from employee data; the tariffs shown are not legally binding.

anchors.quote: Der Tarifrechner dient der Ermittlung des Quellensteuertarifs.
Die ausgewiesenen Tarife sind nicht rechtsverbindlich.

subject: calculator_scope
statement: Cases not covered by the calculator: fees to artists, athletes and speakers; board fees paid to persons resident abroad; hardship cases; pensions and capital benefits from pension provision.

anchors.quote: 'Gagen an Künstler, Sportler und Referenten', 'Verwaltungsratshonorare, welche an Personen mit Wohnsitz im Ausland bezahlt werden', 'Härtefälle', 'Renten und Kapitalleistungen aus Vorsorge'

subject: calculator_format
statement: Every calculator control is a radio button; there are no dropdowns, free-text or date fields. Until all answers are given, the result shows that information is missing.

anchors.quote: Every control is a radio button. There are no dropdowns, free-text fields or date fields
'Es fehlen noch Angaben um die Tarifbestimmung abzuschliessen.'

subject: cross_border_tariff
statement: The residence/cross-border block was explored exhaustively only for married + Y + 1 child and for Ersatzeinkünfte; for tariffs A/B/H it was only spot-checked.

anchors.quote: For A/B/H it was spot-checked only via DE daily return + certificate (L0Y, L1N, M0N, M0Y, P1Y, P3N) and LI more than 45 days / Anderes Land (A0N).

subject: child_count
statement: The full cross-product of child paths × residence paths × confession × civil status was not enumerated.

anchors.quote: The full cross-product of child paths × residence paths × confession × civil status was not enumerated (combinatorial).

subject: children
statement: Not tested: more than 3 children (upper limit unknown), whether 'Kind löschen' recomputes correctly, and tariff D or other special tariffs.

anchors.quote: Not tested: more than 3 children (the upper limit of 'Ein weiteres Kind erfassen' is unknown); whether 'Kind löschen' recomputes correctly; tariff D or other special tariffs (none appeared in any path).

subject: calculator_format
statement: A hidden 'Beispiele' area shows example tariff tags H3N and P3N, which were not used as inputs.

anchors.quote: A visually hidden 'Beispiele' area shows the tags H3N and P3N.
